retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, warm-toned close-up portrait featuring 90s urban styling with a mix of pixelated and condensed display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate portrait of a male subject with long dark hair and a red paisley bandana, characterized by warm, saturated lighting and a distinct contrast between pixel-art display text and condensed sans-serif subtitles.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's intense gaze as the primary focal point
Red bandana providing a vibrant horizontal color break
Top-right pixelated logo balancing the bottom-right condensed text
Warm yellow/orange highlights against deep shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally but slightly angled, filling 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, framed by loose strands of dark hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes to the red bandana, then to the top-right logo, and finally down to the bottom-right title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject's face and hair.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in hair and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red in the bandana and yellow in the typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in warm hues with deep, crushed blacks.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and primary red/yellow accents

letterConstructionRules: Top logo uses a stepped, pixelated outline effect
Bottom text uses ultra-condensed vertical proportions
Heavy use of outlines to separate text from busy backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: O-shaped characters in the logo contain internal geometric patterns
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between digital/pixelated tech aesthetic and sleek/modern condensed forms.

preserve: Pixelated edges of the top logo
Condensed nature of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the stepped, digital look of the primary branding.
Provides the necessary vertical tension for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tight close-up portrait of a man with long dark hair, wearing a red paisley bandana, with warm orange-yellow lighting and deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a pixelated block-letter logo in the top right with a double outline, and ultra-condensed sans-serif text in the bottom right with a yellow gradient fill.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and high-contrast?
Does the top text have a pixelated/stepped edge?
Is the bandana a prominent red element?
Is the bottom text vertically condensed?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color cast
Degree of pixelation in the logo
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the background
Check that the bandana color pops against the skin tones
Verify the pixelated effect looks intentional and not like a low-quality image
Confirm the eyes are the sharpest point of focus
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast warm portrait with a red accessory and a mix of 8-bit and condensed typography.
